modules.title: Introduction to Asa (Culture and Customs)
modules.html:
Yoruba marriage, naming ceremonies and festivals. This section covers introduction to asa (culture and customs).

Key points

  • Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Culture' — Àṣà.

Worked examples

Q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Culture'?
A: Àṣà — Culture is 'Àṣà'.

Q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Ẹ̀fọ̀n'?
A: Buffalo — 'Ẹ̀fọ̀n' is the Yoruba name for a Buffalo.

More key points

  • Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Culture' — Àṣà.

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Culture'?
quiz.solution: Culture is 'Àṣà'.

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Ẹ̀fọ̀n'?
quiz.solution: 'Ẹ̀fọ̀n' is the Yoruba name for a Buffalo.

quiz.q: Èwo ni 'Nasal Vowel' nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí?
quiz.solution: 'in' is a nasal vowel in Yoruba phonology.

quiz.q: Inú 'Sàngó', àmì ohùn wo ni ó wà lórí 'o'?
quiz.solution: In Sàngó, the 'o' carries a high tone (Mi).

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Oriki'?
quiz.solution: Oriki are panegyrics or praise poetry used to highlight lineage or character.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni iṣẹ́-abínibí Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Farming (Àgbẹ̀) is a primary traditional occupation of the Yoruba.

quiz.q: Èwo ni fáwẹ̀lì àránmú?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: an.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Plural'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọ̀pọ̀.

quiz.q: Orísun Yorùbá ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ilé-Ifẹ̀.

quiz.q: Akọni obìnrin Ifẹ̀:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Mọ́remí.

quiz.q: Ta ni ó kọ 'Rẹ́rẹ́ Kún'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Oládèjọ Okédìjí.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Stand'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Dìde.

quiz.q: Ọba wo ni o ni ade 'Are'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ọọ̀ni.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Ìwà lẹwà'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Character is beauty.

quiz.q: Èwo ni òrìṣà ti a fi 'Ìgbín' bọ?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ọbàtálá.

quiz.q: Kí ni àpèjúwe 'Ẹranko'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Animal.

quiz.q: Kí ni àpèjúwe fún 'Àbíkú'?
options: Ọmọ tí ó ń kú, tí ó tún ń padà wá
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ọmọ tí ó ń kú, tí ó tún ń padà wá.

quiz.q: Èwo ni kọ́ńsónáǹtì 'fèrè' nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: s.

quiz.q: Ta ni Olórí àwọn apẹja ní àṣà Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Lígbàdì.

quiz.q: Ìtàn 'Sùúrù lérè' kọ́ wa ní...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ìwà sùúrù.

quiz.q: Ta ni ó jẹ́ 'Yeye'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ìyá.

quiz.q: Iye lẹ́tà tí ó wà nínú áábídì Yorùbá jẹ́:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dọ́gbọ̀n (25).

quiz.q: Kí ni à ń pe 'Pronoun'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀-Arọ́pò Orúkọ.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'School' ní Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ilé-Ìwé.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'House'?
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Ilé.
